items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1963-03-28
items.q: I had a little fella named George Washington. Nice trombone player... one of my good friends right there stranded.

ctx.x: But now... When that, uh... Before they put the union in here... And... Fellas come around, you don't want to sit in, you know, something like that. Okay, man. Blow something for me. Well, I'd go back to town, you know, man. Color cap there is. How long you don't stay? That's all right. I'd be here to come back. Well, I'd go back there. Where George and Boyd in there, most playing. Honest... Uh... Playin' back in the district back there. Hang out around there, George Washington. And... Well, that drum won't come…

items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1963-03-23
items.q: I had a little fella named George Washington. Nice trombone player. ... Out there, I was playing with Eve Ann Thomas, Black Eagle Band.

ctx.x: Well, that's all right. I'll be here to come back. Well, I'll go back there where George and Boyd and him once playing. I was playing. I was, uh, playing back in the district back there. Hang out around there, George Washington. Well, that drum won't come there and relieve me, you know. Mm-hmm. When they wasn't doing anything. Mm-hmm. Well, I'd come back and just by the time I knew they gonna close up, see. Well, I just know the man ain't made no money. You know, I'm working regular. Yeah, man. You know, this…
I said, man, you want to go in home?
